info.name: FilmCraft integration
info.summary: Edit videos in Nextcloud with the FilmCraft video editor
info.description:
Open a video (MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, MXF, MPEG-TS) or a FilmCraft project in Files with **Edit in FilmCraft** and edit right in the browser, the way you know from Premiere Pro: the timeline, trimming, transitions, effects, color, audio, titles and captions.
- A video opens in a new project; **Save** stores the project (.fcproj) in the folder you pick, next to the video by default, and later saves go to that file. - Opening a saved project fetches its media from your Nextcloud. - Exports (renders) store the file in any folder you pick. - If someone else changes the project while you have it open, you choose whether to replace their version or save a copy. - Optionally, clicking a video or project in Files opens it in FilmCraft.
FilmCraft runs entirely in your browser as WebAssembly. Files go only between your browser and your Nextcloud, and the server needs no extra software.
This is a community integration based on [FilmCraft](https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft) by the ArtCraft team, an open-source, Rust-native video editor. It embeds a build of FilmCraft and is not made or endorsed by the ArtCraft team.
**Requirements:** a browser with WebGPU or WebGL2, and a web server that serves `.wasm` files as `application/wasm` (Nextcloud's own Apache and nginx configurations do).
info.author: Britton Couchman
